resources.content:
# Released GPU Fractioning 0.1.9 manifests

These resources are rendered from the upstream chart, not a runtime fork.
The CRD installs first; the operand bundle depends on it. Fleet creates the
release namespace through defaultNamespace; the bundles do not own/delete it.
The default CR is restricted to GPU2 plus an explicit runtime nomination label.
Do not remove either selector until that worker has completed acceptance.

Chart archive SHA256: `238c08d45f1087b07b2793e7ee9e9e6b2f23a12e0bdbd680e37e3ab1b5479e58`.
Upstream source: https://github.com/kai-scheduler/gpu-fractioning/tree/v0.1.9

Reproduce the input from the repository root (CHART is the released archive):

```sh
helm template gpu-fractioning "$CHART" -n gpu-fractioning --include-crds \
  -f platform-staging/gpu/upstream-sharing/fraction-values.yaml \
  --set crdUpgrader.enabled=false > /tmp/fraction-raw.yaml
python3 platform-staging/gpu/upstream-sharing/prepare.py fraction-postrender \
  < /tmp/fraction-raw.yaml > /tmp/fraction-scoped.yaml
```

Split CustomResourceDefinition documents into the CRD bundle; put the other
documents in this bundle. Do not render a Namespace resource: Fleet creates
the release namespace before Helm and does not give it Helm ownership.
Remove only `helm.sh/hook*` annotations from the default CR. It is an ordinary
GitOps-managed resource so the released post-install hook cannot create an
unscoped default configuration outside the post-renderer. The chart's CRD
upgrade hook is disabled because Fleet owns the released CRD directly.
The selector, K3s sockets, fail-open=false, retroactive enforcement=true,
maintenance toleration and time-slicing-only setting are CPS configuration;
operator, fractiond, mpsd and metricsd remain upstream 0.1.9.

Verified registry manifest digests for the published `v0.1.9` tags:

- operator: `sha256:83e0aa29b0951c58b5565cbc50b2ae1900da25c78cdfcdf6eddea437748fe22c`
- fractiond: `sha256:29c5fca25c1b35f22cf9f1e6c53acaa79d0b9f722ed6e8417caf438c06cd3739`
- metricsd: `sha256:7a619c92651d0744bcd80745be264f3b6c213ad4f3a12fef19a339df422af2bf`
- mpsd: `sha256:f161d6c653c668e49e384ae15794421777464248c5e533660ac26b006787b102`

The unprefixed `0.1.9` image tags do not exist. The initial selected-node pilot
exposed this pinning mistake before daemon startup; corrected manifests use the
released chart appVersion `v0.1.9`. Rendering alone cannot verify image availability.

# Generated from the released gpu-fractioning 0.1.9 chart. See README.md.

    app.kubernetes.io/name: gpu-fractioning
    app.kubernetes.io/instance: gpu-fractioning
    app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: Helm
    app.kubernetes.io/version: v0.1.9
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: ServiceAccount
metadata:
  name: gpu-fractioning-daemon
  namespace: gpu-fractioning
  labels:

    app.kubernetes.io/name: gpu-fractioning

apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:

  namespace: gpu-fractioning
  labels:
    helm.sh/chart: gpu-fractioning-v0.1.9
    app.kubernetes.io/name: gpu-fractioning
    app.kubernetes.io/instance: gpu-fractioning
    app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: Helm
    app.kubernetes.io/version: v0.1.9
spec:
  type: ClusterIP
  selector:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: gpu-fractioning
    app.kubernetes.io/instance: gpu-fractioning
  ports:
  - name: http
    port: 8080
    targetPort: metrics
    protocol: TCP
---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: gpu-fractioning
  namespace: gpu-fractioning
  labels:
    helm.sh/chart: gpu-fractioning-v0.1.9
    app.kubernetes.io/name: gpu-fractioning
    app.kubernetes.io/instance: gpu-fractioning
    app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: Helm
    app.kubernetes.io/version: v0.1.9
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app.kubernetes.io/name: gpu-fractioning
      app.kubernetes.io/instance: gpu-fractioning
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app.kubernetes.io/name: gpu-fractioning
        app.kubernetes.io/instance: gpu-fractioning
    spec:
      serviceAccountName: gpu-fractioning
      securityContext:
        runAsNonRoot: true
      containers:
      - name: manager
        image: ghcr.io/kai-scheduler/gpu-fractioning/operator:v0.1.9
        imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
        env:
        - name: POD_NAMESPACE
          valueFrom:
            fieldRef:
              fieldPath: metadata.namespace
        - name: FRACTIOND_IMAGE_REPOSITORY
          value: ghcr.io/kai-scheduler/gpu-fractioning/fractiond
        - name: FRACTIOND_IMAGE_TAG
          value: v0.1.9
        - name: FRACTIOND_IMAGE_PULL_POLICY
          value: IfNotPresent
        - name: METRICSD_IMAGE_REPOSITORY
          value: ghcr.io/kai-scheduler/gpu-fractioning/metricsd
        - name: METRICSD_IMAGE_TAG
          value: v0.1.9
        - name: METRICSD_IMAGE_PULL_POLICY
          value: IfNotPresent
        - name: MPSD_IMAGE_REPOSITORY
          value: ghcr.io/kai-scheduler/gpu-fractioning/mpsd
        - name: MPSD_IMAGE_TAG
          value: v0.1.9
        - name: MPSD_IMAGE_PULL_POLICY
          value: IfNotPresent
        - name: MPSD_AUDIT_LOG
          value: 'true'
        - name: SUPPORT_SM_SHARING
          value: 'false'
        - name: SKIP_GPU_STACK_VERSION_CHECKS
          value: 'false'
        - name: DAEMON_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_NAME
          value: gpu-fractioning-daemon
        - name: FIPS_MODE
          value: 'off'
        args:
        - --leader-elect
        - --health-probe-bind-address=:8081
        - --metrics-bind-address=:8080
        - --metrics-secure=false
        ports:
        - name: health
          containerPort: 8081
          protocol: TCP
        - name: metrics
          containerPort: 8080
          protocol: TCP
        livenessProbe:
          httpGet:
            path: /healthz
            port: health
          initialDelaySeconds: 15
          periodSeconds: 20
        readinessProbe:
          httpGet:
            path: /readyz
            port: health
          initialDelaySeconds: 5
          periodSeconds: 10
        resources:
          limits:
            cpu: 500m
            memory: 128Mi
          requests:
            cpu: 100m
            ephemeral-storage: 100Mi
            memory: 64Mi
        securityContext:
          allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
          capabilities:
            drop:
            - ALL
      terminationGracePeriodSeconds: 10
---
apiVersion: gpu-fractioning.kai.scheduler/v1alpha1
kind: GpuFractioningConfig
metadata:
  name: default
  labels:
    helm.sh/chart: gpu-fractioning-v0.1.9
    app.kubernetes.io/name: gpu-fractioning
    app.kubernetes.io/instance: gpu-fractioning
    app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: Helm
    app.kubernetes.io/version: v0.1.9
spec:
  nodeSelector:
    cps.unileoben.ac.at/fractioning-runtime: upstream
  tolerations:
  - effect: NoSchedule
    key: nvidia.com/gpu
    operator: Exists
  - effect: NoSchedule
    key: cps.unileoben.ac.at/maintenance
    operator: Exists
  runtimeClassName: nvidia
  fractioningAgent:
    criSocketPath: /run/k3s/containerd/containerd.sock
    failOpen: false
    retroactiveEnforcement: true
    nriSocketPath: /var/run/nri/nri.sock
  metricsAgent:
    enabled: true
    # GPU Operator writes this only after validating the current driver installation.
    # File (not FileOrCreate) blocks container creation until /run readiness exists.
    volumes:
    - name: gpu-operator-driver-ready
      hostPath:
        path: /run/nvidia/validations/driver-ready
        type: File
    volumeMounts:
    - name: gpu-operator-driver-ready
      mountPath: /run/nvidia/validations/driver-ready
      readOnly: true

---
# Source: gpu-fractioning/templates/monitors.yaml
# metricsd sidecars: per-pod GPU metrics on the fractiond DaemonSet pods. A single
# PodMonitor discovers every metricsd pod — Prometheus creates one scrape target
# per pod, i.e. one per GPU node.
apiVersion: monitoring.coreos.com/v1
kind: PodMonitor
metadata:
  name: gpu-fractioning-metricsd
  namespace: gpu-fractioning
  labels:
    helm.sh/chart: gpu-fractioning-v0.1.9
    app.kubernetes.io/name: gpu-fractioning
    app.kubernetes.io/instance: gpu-fractioning
    app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: Helm
    app.kubernetes.io/version: "v0.1.9"
spec:
  # These values are fixed literals on purpose: the daemon pods are labelled by
  # the operator (daemonmgr.ManagedByValue = "gpu-fractioning" and the component
  # name), not by Helm. The gpu-fractioning.name helper would follow nameOverride and
  # stop matching the operator-set label, so it must not be used here.
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: gpu-fractioning
      app.kubernetes.io/component: fractiond
  namespaceSelector:
    matchNames:
      - gpu-fractioning
  podMetricsEndpoints:
    - port: metrics
      path: /metrics
      interval: 30s
---
# Source: gpu-fractioning/templates/monitors.yaml
# Controller metrics: reconcile counters + node/daemon gauges, scraped over plain
# HTTP from the metrics Service.
apiVersion: monitoring.coreos.com/v1
kind: ServiceMonitor
metadata:
  name: gpu-fractioning
  namespace: gpu-fractioning
  labels:
    helm.sh/chart: gpu-fractioning-v0.1.9
    app.kubernetes.io/name: gpu-fractioning
    app.kubernetes.io/instance: gpu-fractioning
    app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: Helm
    app.kubernetes.io/version: "v0.1.9"
spec:
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app.kubernetes.io/name: gpu-fractioning
      app.kubernetes.io/instance: gpu-fractioning
  namespaceSelector:
    matchNames:
      - gpu-fractioning
  endpoints:
    - port: http
      scheme: http
      path: /metrics
      interval: 30s
      scrapeTimeout: 10s
resources.name: stock-monitors.yaml
